provenance.title: Reviewer checks
provenance.covers: Which checks the Reviewer runs, their wording and severity. The checks are our own plain list. The listed documents are only places to check against.

sources.name: Approved Document M (UK government), for door and space rules. Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
Approved Document P: Electrical safety, dwellings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
Approved Document F: Ventilation (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

then.name: A door that opens into furniture
then.sentence: In the {room}, the swing of the {a} runs into the {b}.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. A door that opens into the room needs a free square as wide as the door.

then.name: A light with no switch
then.sentence: The {room} has lights but no switch to turn them on.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Every lit room needs a switch.

then.name: A room with no window light
then.sentence: The {room} has no window, so it gets no daylight.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. A living room, bedroom or kitchen should have a window.

then.name: Items out of date after an earlier change
then.sentence: The {a} may be out of date: something it was based on changed and it was not re-checked.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. An item that waited too long.

then.name: Items kept as they are
then.sentence: You chose to keep the {a} as it is, so a suggestion for it was skipped.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. A skipped suggestion.

then.name: Locked items that need your look
then.sentence: The {a} is Locked and out of date with earlier work. It was not changed. Please take a look.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. A Locked item is never changed.
